Name: Charles' Customisable Chicken Recolours
Author: subarucrosstrekbiggestfan
Description:
Charles' Customisable Chicken Recolours is a retexture that does more than just redo textures in the game, it redoes textures in the game (as of right now) 2-3 times over to provide players with the customisation options of their dreams to fit their own aesthetic and make the game feel personal to them.

No changes or edits need to be made to the files to add them to your game, you just need to unzip the downloaded file and place it into your mods folder.

Made with <3 by subarucrosstrekbiggestfan.

Downloads.Description: Main version. Includes white, brown, golden, void and blue chickens.
